name: @nerima-games/mx-multiplayer
description: Network synchronisation for the nerima-games Minecraft-clone rebuild: wire protocol, frame codec, connection state machine and the transport Port. Transport and protocol only — multiplayer screens belong to mx-ui.
author: takeokunn

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.preview.json --pretty false
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings index.ts domain stages scripts test apps
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix index.ts domain stages scripts test apps
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm check:deps && pnpm api:check && pnpm test
